title: kbarticle
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, kbarticletemplateid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid, subjectid, transactioncurrencyid.

adx_averagerating.description: The average rating of this article.

adx_averagerating_int.description: The average rating of this article, rounded to a whole number (positive integer).

adx_downvotes.description: The number of negative vote ratings applied to this article.

adx_ratingsum.description: The sum of the values of all ratings applied to this article.

adx_upvotes.description: The number of positive vote ratings applied to this article.

articlexml.description: Shows the article content and formatting, stored as XML.

comments.description: Comments regarding the knowledge base article.

content.description: Description of the content of the knowledge base article.

createdon.description: Date and time when the knowledge base article was created.

description.description: Type additional information that describes the knowledge base article.

entityimage.description: The default image for the entity.

exchangerate.description: Shows the conversion rate of the record's currency.

importsequencenumber.description: Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

kbarticleid.description: Shows the ID of the article.

keywords.description: Keywords to be used for searches in knowledge base articles.

languagecode.description: Select which language the article must be available in.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the knowledge base article was last modified.

msa_publishtoweb.description: If set to Yes, the article will be visible and searchable on portals connected to this organization.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

statecode.description: Shows whether the knowledge base article is in draft, unapproved, or published status.

title.description: Type a subject or descriptive name for the article to assist with article searches.

versionnumber.description: Title of the knowledge base article.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the knowledge base article.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the article.

_kbarticletemplateid_value.description: Choose the template that you want to use as a base for creating the new article.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the knowledge base article.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the kbarticle.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization associated with the article.

_subjectid_value.description: Choose the subject of the article to assist with article searches.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Choose the local currency for the record to make sure budgets are reported in the correct currency.
